search_scope: All1522records title/keywords/instruction/context searched for swinghandle/swing handle/multipoint/enclosure/pop-up/lift-and-turn and broaderlatch/lid/panel terms; nearest full definitions read. No exact swinghandle title found. Keywordabsence is not proof ofmechanicalabsence.

neighbors.title: Lock a multipoint back door: lift the handle before the key will turn
neighbors.comparison: Shares multipoint locking and a handle-dependent interlock. It raises a separate lever to permit key rotation and locks a fixed door mock-up. S1 releases a flush handle with a cap, pivots that same handle out, rotates its spindle to unload/release a cam, then actually opens a hinged lid. Generic mechanical sequencing or multipoint terminology is not claimed new.

neighbors.title: Open a panel held shut by a spring plunger
neighbors.comparison: Shares release-before-opening. Its separate spring plunger must remain withdrawn while another hand swings the panel clear. S1 has a cap catch that releases handle pop-up and a distinct spindle rotation/decompression stage; it does not require holding a separate plunger throughout opening.

neighbors.title: Release a two-latch lid and lift it out with both hands
neighbors.comparison: Shares latched-cover access. It holds two independent sliding latches inward simultaneously, removes the lid and places it elsewhere. S1 has a sequential cap/pivot/spindle mechanism on one captive swinghandle and a hinged lid, with no lid removal.

neighbors.title: Open the lift landing door with the drop key
neighbors.comparison: Shares interlock release and door opening. It uses a loose hooked key through a wall slot to lift an unseen gravity bar, coordinating with a sliding door. S1 operates an exposed captive cap and flush handle, changing manipulation axes before opening a hinged lid.

neighbors.title: Adjust and retain an equipment enclosure compression latch
neighbors.comparison: Same broad equipment-enclosure family, already ours and frozen. It adjusts an unloaded threaded grip-length knob, closes a wing cam and demonstrates retained clamp force/gap. S1 opens an already-latched enclosure by releasing a pop-up pivot and rotating the handle to disengage its cam. Duration, colors and layout are not the distinction.

neighbors.title: Open a bottle with a detented safety loop and rocker latch
neighbors.comparison: Already ours and frozen. Both require releasing mechanical restraints before opening. The bottle is a free object requiring upright stabilization and separate safety-loop/rocker-latch manipulation. S1 is bench-bolted and requires pressing a cap to release a flush pop-up handle, pivot lift to unlock a spindle, then load-bearing cam rotation. Industrial naming or a larger box alone is not a novelty claim.

neighbors.title: Close and bolt a double-door enclosure whose astragal forces the leaf order
neighbors.comparison: Shares enclosure access hardware. It closes two leaves in the astragal-imposed order and throws a bolt; S1 releases a single cap/pop/swing assembly to open a hinged lid, with no dual-leaf overlap or separate top bolt.

neighbors.title: Release a cabinet remote latch and retrieve a parts box
neighbors.comparison: Already ours and frozen. Its spatially separate side paddle releases a rotary door latch before cargo retrieval. S1 has no mapped remote actuator or cargo retrieval; its dependency is local cap release, handle pop-out and spindle rotation.

proposed_distinction: Coupled cap catch, handle-pop pivot, rotational spindle/cam and lid-opening dependency, with passive loaded contact mechanics. Officialreviewers may judge differences insufficient.
